citations.title: Prime Minister Netanyahu condoles Master Sergeant Nadav Kali and Master Sergeant Ofek Moalem
citations.excerpt: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu: Together with all citizens of Israel, my wife and I grieve over the fall of Master Sergeant (Res.) Nadav Kali and Master Sergeant (Res.) Ofek Moalem in a tragic incident in Gaza yesterday. Nadav and Ofek, of blessed memory, were brave reserve soldiers who defended Israel's security. We embrace their families in their difficult hour and send them our deepest condolences. The IDF is investigating the incident; all necessary lessons must be learned and implemented to ensure the safety and security of IDF soldiers.

citations.title: MFA mourns two IDF soldiers from the 7007th Battalion who fell in Gaza
citations.excerpt: We mourn the loss of two IDF soldiers from the 7007th Battalion, 16th Brigade, who fell in combat in Gaza: Master Sergeant (Res.) Nadav Kali, 24, from Har Halutz. Master Sergeant (Res.) Ofek Moalem, 23, from Jerusalem. Our hearts are with their families and loved ones. May their memory be a blessing. The Foreign Ministry names the same two reserve soldiers later identified by the Prime Minister as having fallen in a tragic incident in Gaza.

citations.title: Two reservists killed in IDF drone explosion accident during operations in Gaza
citations.excerpt: Two IDF reservists were killed Thursday after a small explosive drone they were operating in the Gaza Strip crashed for an unknown reason and exploded shortly afterward, the military announced on Friday. The troops were named as Master Sgt. (res.) Nadav Kali, 24, from Har Halutz, and Master Sgt. (res.) Ofek Moalem, 23, from Jerusalem. Both served in the Jerusalem Brigade 7007th Battalion. According to a preliminary investigation, the two soldiers had been operating first-person view drones known as Atalef from an army post inside the military Gaza buffer zone in the Strip north. A second drone crashed inside the army post during takeoff. The soldiers approached the crashed drone several minutes later, picked it up, and it then exploded. The pair were taken to Barzilai Medical Center in Ashkelon. The military has temporarily grounded all small drones capable of carrying explosive payloads. IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir has ordered a panel of experts to investigate the deadly accident.

citations.title: IDF: Hamas commander Hassan Mahmoud Siam who held hostages eliminated with Adham Ziara
citations.excerpt: ELIMINATED: 2 Hamas terrorists, Hassan Mahmoud Siam, a commander in Hamas military wing and Adham Sabhi Salim Ziara, another operative in Hamas military wing. Mahmoud Siam infiltrated Israel during the October 7 Massacre and was involved in the holding of hostages Amit Soussana, Keith and Aviva Siegel and Dafna Elyakim in Gaza. Recently, the terrorists advanced attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops and operated to restore Hamas capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. Additionally, they were involved in shooting attacks against IDF troops and in planting explosive devices in the Yellow Line area, and were eliminated in order to remove the threat they posed.

citations.title: IDF: 16 key terrorists involved in transferring funds and financing Hamas terror activities eliminated
citations.excerpt: 16 Key Terrorists Involved in Transferring Funds and Financing Hamas Terror Activities Have Been Eliminated by the IDF. These funds are used by Hamas to finance its terrorists, build up its weapons capabilities, restore terrorist infrastructure, and advance terrorist plots against Israeli civilians and IDF soldiers. The Israel Defense Forces presented the sixteen eliminations as a campaign against the money networks that keep Hamas armed activity running after the ceasefire understandings.

citations.title: IDF footage of a 2km underground terror tunnel dismantled in southern Gaza Yellow Line
citations.excerpt: WATCH: Footage of a 2km long underground terror tunnel that was dismantled as part of operations to clear terrorist infrastructure in southern Gaza within the Yellow Line area. The Israel Defense Forces released the video on Friday to document the length of the shaft and to present the work of troops clearing Hamas infrastructure from territory the army says it holds under the Yellow Line arrangements.

citations.title: Netanyahu UN speech: Israel prevented the genocide Mamdani Hamas buddies would have done
citations.excerpt: Accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century. Listen to Colonel John Spencer. He is the head of Urban Warfare studies at West Point. Here is what Colonel Spencer says: Israel has done more to prevent civilian casualties in war than any other military in history. We have taken innumerable steps to protect the civilian population. Is this genocide? Of course not. It is the opposite of genocide. Mr. Mamdani, you falsely and repeatedly accuse Israel of genocide. Israel did not commit genocide. Israel prevented genocide. On October 7, 2023 the darkest day in Israel history thousands of Palestinian terrorists stormed into Israel from Gaza. Altogether, they slaughtered 1200 Israelis that day.

citations.title: Al Jazeera replies after Netanyahu called the network a toxic media outlet
citations.excerpt: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu called Al Jazeera a toxic media outlet and the media an eighth front in Israel war. But Israel has killed Palestinian journalists, shut Al Jazeera operations and restricted media access to Gaza. Al Jazeera explains. The post treats the Prime Minister United Nations charge that mainstream media and social media form an eighth front as an attack on press freedom rather than as a rebuttal of genocide language, and it does not engage the IDF named-target notices published the same day.

claims.title: Netanyahu told the UN genocide is the greatest lie of the century
claims.text: In the General Assembly address carried by The Times of Israel, Netanyahu said accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century, cited Colonel John Spencer on civilian-casualty prevention, told New York mayor Mamdani that Israel prevented genocide, and said Hamas slaughtered 1200 Israelis on October 7, 2023.

passages.text: The Israel-local Friday-into-Saturday window opened on a home-front casualty: two Jerusalem Brigade reservists died after an Atalef first-person-view drone crashed inside a northern Gaza post and exploded when they picked it up. The Prime Minister called it a tragic incident under IDF investigation; the Foreign Ministry named Nadav Kali, 24, and Ofek Moalem, 23.

The same day the army published named Gaza operations: 16 finance-network operatives, hostage-holding commander Hassan Mahmoud Siam, and footage of a 2km Yellow Line tunnel. Netanyahu told the UN that accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century.

A preliminary military probe said a second Atalef drone crashed on takeoff inside the post; the two soldiers of the 7007th Battalion approached minutes later. They were declared dead at Barzilai Medical Center in Ashkelon. Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered an expert panel and the army grounded small explosive-payload drones.

The IDF said Siam infiltrated Israel on October 7 and helped hold Amit Soussana, Keith and Aviva Siegel and Dafna Elyakim, then advanced shooting attacks and explosive devices on the Yellow Line. The army also released 2km tunnel footage from that zone.

Prime Minister Netanyahu said Nadav and Ofek were brave reserve soldiers who defended Israel security and demanded that the IDF learn every lesson required to protect soldiers. He separately told the United Nations that accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century and that Israel prevented genocide.

Al Jazeera English answered the UN speech by saying Netanyahu called the network a toxic media outlet and the media an eighth front, and that Israel has killed Palestinian journalists, shut Al Jazeera operations and restricted media access to Gaza.

Watch the expert panel on the Atalef explosion and whether the grounding of small explosive drones is lifted before the next operational cycle. Watch whether Hamas or Palestinian outlets name Siam and Ziara or continue to describe the same strikes only as ceasefire violations.

passages.text: A first-person-view Atalef drone completed its mission from a northern Gaza buffer-zone post. A second crashed on takeoff inside the post. Several minutes later the two 7007th Battalion reservists approached, picked it up, and it exploded. They were taken to Barzilai Medical Center in Ashkelon, where their deaths were declared.

Prime Minister Netanyahu said he and his wife grieve with all citizens of Israel over Master Sergeant Nadav Kali and Master Sergeant Ofek Moalem and that every necessary lesson must be learned to protect IDF soldiers. Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered an expert panel, and small explosive-payload drones were grounded pending a new assessment.

passages.text: The durable claim in this window is that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza. Netanyahu answered it on the General Assembly floor as the greatest lie of the century, cited West Point urban-warfare specialist Colonel John Spencer, told Mayor Mamdani that Israel prevented genocide, and restated the October 7 death toll of 1200 Israelis.

Al Jazeera English converted the same speech into a press-freedom counter-narrative: toxic media outlet, eighth front, killed Palestinian journalists, shut operations, restricted Gaza access. That reply does not address the IDF named-target notices issued Friday.
